verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents persistent browser sessions that keep cookies, storage and tabs (skyvern-docs-21, skyvern-docs-10) and reusable profiles (skyvern-docs-39, skyvern-docs-40). Its OpenAPI-generated API reference covers browser-session endpoints, so session management is programmatic (skyvern-supp-api-reference). Nothing in the pack documents running a concurrent fleet or publishes concurrency limits; "set organization limits" (skyvern-docs-43) is too vague to count. missing for 10: documented concurrent-session/parallelism limits, evidence of running many sessions in parallel at scale, details of session lifecycle endpoints (create/list/close), independent corroboration.
